# lakekeeper_tag_attachments (Data Source)

The `lakekeeper_tag_attachments` data source performs a reverse lookup of all objects directly carrying a governance tag definition.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag/operation/list_tag_attachments)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_tag_attachments" "pii" {
  project_id        = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  tag_definition_id = "37cf8760-5092-4d5d-8b29-a6b46a45f067"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The UUID of the tag definition.

### Optional

- `target_type` (String) Optional filter by target type (`warehouse`, `namespace`, `table`, `view`, `generic-table`, `column`).
- `value` (String) Optional filter by tag value.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Optional filter by warehouse UUID.

### Read-Only

- `attachments` (Attributes List) Objects carrying this tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))

<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag was applied.
- `field_id` (Number) Iceberg field ID, when `target_type` is `column`.
- `generic_table_id` (String) Generic table UUID, when `target_type` is `generic-table`.
- `namespace_id` (String) Namespace UUID, when `target_type` is `namespace`.
- `source` (String) How the tag was applied.
- `table_id` (String) Table UUID, when `target_type` is `table` or `column`.
- `target_type` (String) Target kind (`warehouse`, `namespace`, `table`, `view`, `generic-table`, `column`).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag was last updated.
- `value` (String) Tag value, if set.
- `view_id` (String) View UUID, when `target_type` is `view`.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Warehouse UUID.
